read_file.description: Use absolute paths for files. This operation reads files outside of the agent's sandbox.
read_file.cursor-notes: Recommend disabling as cursor's read_file tool works within the agent's sandbox.

read_multiple_files.description: Use absolute paths for files. This operation reads files outside of the agent's sandbox.
read_multiple_files.cursor-notes: Direct the AI to use the read_multiple_files tool to read a list of files to efficiently gather context

write_file.description: Use absolute paths for files. This operation occurs outside of Cursor's sandbox.
write_file.cursor-notes: Disabled by default as this bypasses the agent's sandbox.

edit_file.description: Use absolute paths for files. This operation edits files outside of the agent's sandbox.
edit_file.cursor-notes: Disabled by default as this bypasses the agent's sandbox.

create_directory.description: Use absolute paths for files. This operation occurs outside of Cursor's sandbox.
create_directory.cursor-notes: Enabled to reduce shell calls, but agent can do this via terminal

list_directory.cursor-notes: Disabled by default to encourage use of the directory tree

directory_tree.description: Use absolute paths. Use this tool to list directory contents, verify file and directory existance.
directory_tree.cursor-notes: A single call to the root of the workspace should make the AI fully aware of the directory structure

move_file.description: Use absolute paths for files. This operation occurs outside of the Agent's sandbox.
move_file.cursor-notes: Disabled as this bypasses the agent's sandbox.

search_files.description: Use absolute paths for files. This tool searches outside of the Agent's sandbox.
search_files.cursor-notes: The agent can effectively search with grep, leaving this enabled for now to evaluate its effectiveness

get_file_info.description: Prefer directory_tree tool for verifying file existance. Use absolute paths for files.
get_file_info.cursor-notes: Leaving this tool eanbled for now but not sure if it is needed given directory_tree

list_allowed_directories.cursor-notes: This tool should likely be deprecated as it's a leftover from more general file server capabilities
